newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkey says it cancelled Cobra order from USA.
newsitem.headline: Turkey says it cancelled Cobra order from USA.

text.p: Turkey said on Wednesday it had cancelled an order for 10 Cobra helicoper gunships from Washington that would have been used against Kurd guerrillas in 12-year-old armed struggle in southeast of the country.
"We informed the United States offically that we have decided not to buy the Cobra helicopters, " foreign ministry spokesman Sermet Atacanli told reporters.
"Yes, we have been officially notified about that" a U.S embassy official told Reuters. He gave no reason for the cancellation of the order from Textron Inc's Bell Helicopter.
Turkish officals have often complained about a delay in handing over the helicopters.
U.S-Turkish relations have come under increasing scrutiny and criticism in Congress earlier this year, particularly because of Ankara's treatment of Kurds seeking autonomy.

A coalition of Democrats and Republicans has blocked the normally routine sale of the attack helicopters to Turkey, saying they might be used to attack Kurdish rebels in the fighting in which more than 21,000 people have died since 1984.
